premises.statement: Model this finite continuous paved street patch for two seconds. Adopt no new unobserved entrant, falling object, opening door or pedestrian emergence into it. These are falsifiable conditional exclusions rather than assertions about the whole world. The road polygon estimates curb-to-curb pavement including parking pavement; it does not declare occupied parking spaces free. Front and side views support the unchanged lateral boundaries and forward crop. The supplied back image shows roadway continuing rearward past x=-4; this rear cross-section is a conservative finite crop within observed pavement, not a newly inferred curb or an extension across a physical boundary. The previous x=-3 cut unnecessarily truncated that visible pavement. Target center positions and intended route remain unchanged.
